description: Image-grounded staples-marker side-whiteboard hard benchmark task for writing L. Success is decided by the VLM judge from marker-tip ink evidence; rollout/contact metrics are diagnostic only.

runner_args.tool_refs_policy: Use reviewed task-conditioned staples_marker refs from the marker_trace tool-label review file or a regenerated publishable tool-ref package; do not depend on historical path-named runtime roots.

scene_initialization.trajectory_policy: No pre-authored letter trajectory is a method input; VLM scene refs define start, optional path_points, and explicit end from public side-board evidence.
scene_initialization.start_pose_policy: sample or shift the marker start pose so the tool does not overlap the left-side vertical blank whiteboard at initialization; preview seed 000 places the marker near the robot-hand side with a visible gap before approach.

whiteboard.canonical_preview_policy: Regenerate public whiteboard_front evidence under the benchmark runtime output tree when promoting statistics; do not depend on historical preview roots.

scene_initialization.target_grounding_policy: The shared task-generic VLM scene-ref interface applies. VLM start/path/end refs scaffold compilation and diagnostics; final success requires VLM-judged recognizable marker-tip ink matching the requested letter.
scene_initialization.tool_grounding_policy: Use task-conditioned P3SAM/VLM staples_marker refs: VLM selects the task-facing marker part, then selects tool.contact_point and tool.motion_axis from evidence for that selected part.

mainline_params_pending_review.path_point_policy: parser preserves VLM path_points as the complete scene.motion_path; explicit VLM end_point remains supported for single-endpoint or contact-only tasks
mainline_params_pending_review.task_language_draft: Use this marker to write the letter L on the whiteboard.

ink_evidence_policy.rule: Render black ink only from the reviewed staples_marker tool.contact_point while the whiteboard contact gate passes. Never render ink from the tool center, handle, cap, shaft, gripper, or whole-tool pose alone.
ink_evidence_policy.quality_scope: VLM judge decides success from marker-tip ink evidence; automatic rollout/contact values are diagnostic only.

acceptance.known_difficulty: Current smoke completed the full chain but VLM judge success was low because marker-tip ink is fragmented.
acceptance.scratch_smoke_policy: Local smoke roots may be recorded in lab notes, but publishable benchmark configs do not depend on them.

publish_status_note: Publishable marker runs are regenerated by parttoolgen/src/parttoolgen/cli/runners/run_image_grounded_marker_trace_eval.py under artifacts/image_grounded/marker_trace/. Historical test000 roots are scratch evidence only.

contract_status.notes: VLM judge over produced marker-tip ink is the intended semantic gate for writing L; automatic ink/path/contact metrics are diagnostic.
